title: More Money!
description: This project adds additions to show off your wealth to friends.
body:
Ever wanted a way to show off just how wealthy you've become? More Money adds decorative luxury items and status symbols that let you display your success to your friends.

Build lavish rooms filled with expensive decorations, place rare-looking Suits on armor stands, and collect prestigious cosmetic items that make your base stand out. None of these additions are intended to provide gameplay advantages—they're simply for showing off your accomplishments and adding personality to your world.

Features
Decorative Suits
Display Hats that highlight your in-game wealth
Prestige Monocles
Cosmetic content with no gameplay advantage
Designed to fit naturally into survival and multiplayer worlds

Whether you've filled your vault with diamonds, emeralds, or other treasures, now you have something worthy of putting them on display.

Perfect for multiplayer servers, roleplay worlds, or anyone who enjoys building impressive mansions and treasure rooms.
